recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Medication.package.container or alter current Medication packaging terminology for this DSTU1 link issue; any future packaging terminology changes should be handled under a current tracker that accounts for FHIR-12347 and the later Medication model.
issue_request: FHIR-7746 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy change request reporting that the Medication.package.container example/value-set link led to the wrong medication form/route value set. The accepted resolution was to fix the binding so package container codes came from SNOMED CT where concept is-a 408102007.
initial_application: Git commit 534313123abc479f1c95a22956d9992582f9743c explicitly includes 7746 in its subject and changed source/medication/valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml from SNOMED concept 284009009 to 408102007, applying the requested terminology correction.
additional_context: Medication remains an active current resource in source/fhir.ini, but source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml no longer has Medication.package.container. Later history revisited the terminology in FHIR-12347, implemented an EDQM-derived local code list in 491a59353e, and then removed the package.container model in the GF #13879 Medication refactor 2559032b9b. The remaining legacy package-form ValueSet already contains the 408102007 compose. Community searches found no direct FHIR-7746 discussion or Confluence references; relevant Zulip evidence was the later FHIR-12347 terminology discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the requested fix is already reflected in source history and there is no current Medication.package.container link or binding to repair.
